Fallback Main Landmark

This page keeps the primary explanation inside a main landmark rather than a classic article node with rich metadata. Extraction should still recover several sentences describing how operators calibrated sensors before the outdoor trial began at dawn.

Calibration notebooks list voltage offsets, humidity corrections, and the serial numbers of spare probes packed for the trip. The narrative is intentionally plain so readability heuristics may abstain.

After the trial, teams compared handwritten logs with automated samples and confirmed that the main landmark text alone is sufficient for a concise downstream summary workflow.
